note: Theme tokens of different kinds can no longer silently share a CSS variable: a color `card` and a shadow `card` both declared `--card`, so one replaced the other in `:root`. New build error: `theme: color token 'card' and shadow token 'card' both become the CSS variable --card: rename one`, raised when the theme is registered for any two of colors, `length` and `shadow` (names compared after dots become dashes, so `gray.100` and `gray-100` clash too)
